src: four colored marker pixels at the corners of an axis-aligned rectangle, with two colors paired on opposite corners
path: from each corner marker, follow the rectangle side gap toward adjacent corner markers on the same row or column, excluding the cells occupied by the 3x3 corner glyphs
trajectory: paint grey dashes on side-gap cells whose nearest side-end distance is even
transform: replace each marker with a centered 3x3 glyph whose center keeps the marker color and whose border uses the other marker color; keep background elsewhere
